name: 37174 · Spring Hill, TN
findings: ZIP 37174 (Spring Hill) has 119 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37174 (Spring Hill) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list public events
observations.text: No hobby and sports organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
